source.name: EuroLeague: Bayern unveils its new jersey for the 2026-27 season
source.quote: the club crest sitting cleanly above the Siegmund sponsor logo on the chest
source.note: Opened in a browser (the site blocks scripts). Siegmund's own sponsoring page (https://www.siegmund.com/en-us/Company-Profile/Sports-sponsoring/FC-Bayern-Basketball) says it is the main sponsor with its logo on the chest since 2022/23.

summary: Siegmund (Bernd Siegmund GmbH, a family-run welding-table maker) is on the chest of the 2026-27 jersey (EuroLeague's launch article, 12 June 2026); it has been the team's main sponsor since 2022/23. Not marked complete: the back and the shorts aren't recorded yet.
